row_name: Paired CSF and plasma glucose for GLUT1 deficiency
reason: NOT_PRIMARY_ROUTE (ambiguous): rule 1 does not cover a differential test, and the entry models GLUT1 deficiency as a differential of JAE (a low CSF-to-plasma glucose ratio reassigns the patient to GLUT1 deficiency) to be considered only in atypical or refractory cases, so the test is not the route in a typical case; GLUT1 cases among IGE/JAE-type patients were found by SLC2A1 sequencing (Arsov 2012, PMID:23280796), and no primary report establishing paired CSF/plasma glucose in JAE patients was found, so NOT_DATABLE would also apply; a reviewer could instead treat it as a subset test like the rule 1 GLUT1 absence-epilepsy example [judged]

row_name: Newborn screening by T-cell receptor excision circle quantitation
reason: PRIMARY_ROUTE: standing decision for TREC newborn screening in SCID; CD3delta deficiency is a T-negative SCID with undetectable TRECs, and dried-blood-spot TREC quantitation replaced recognition after infection (clinical diagnosis) as the route by which cases are found; primary report Chan & Puck 2005 (PMID:15696101), whose abstract does not state genotypes; the first verified CD3delta-specific TREC measurement is Jilkina 2014 (PMID:27896105); the leaky form is not reliably detected, hence the subset [judged]

row_name: Newborn screening by T-cell receptor excision circle quantitation
reason: PRIMARY_ROUTE: standing decision for TREC newborn screening in SCID, applied under rule 1 to the complete-deficiency form, which is a T-B+NK+ SCID with undetectable TRECs; TREC quantitation replaced recognition after infection (clinical diagnosis); primary report Chan & Puck 2005 (PMID:15696101), whose abstract does not state genotypes; TRECs first verified as absent in CD3E patients by Firtina 2017 (PMID:28597365); the hypomorphic form is not reliably detected [judged]
